title: FG2-GDN: Enhancing Long-Context Gated Delta Networks with Doubly Fine-Grained Control
selection_reason: The abstract introduces channel-wise delta updates and decoupled key/value scaling for gated delta networks, a linear-attention alternative with linear-time inference. It reports stronger associative recall and long-context understanding at comparable compute.
